environment.description: Same Flask application deployed on EC2 behind an Application Load Balancer. The instance runs with a mandatory AppArmor profile (enforce mode) that confines the application process. The profile restricts sqlite3 operations: the process can open /var/lib/app/users.db with read-only permission (r), and the profile denies write access and creation of journal/WAL files (/var/lib/app/users.db-journal, /var/lib/app/users.db-wal). Additionally, the ALB target group has a fixed-response rule that returns 403 for any request where the query string length exceeds 50 characters (configured via ALB listener rule with condition: query-string length > 50). The application's systemd unit also sets ReadOnlyPaths=/var/lib/app/.

config.security_group: inbound TCP/443 from ALB SG only
